fusions.name: Spotter's Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grain Reader
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 28 damage and ignores armour. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unblinking Focus
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sized Up
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 30% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
